newsitem.title: USA: Subdued U.S. Dec core CPI eases inflation worries.
newsitem.headline: Subdued U.S. Dec core CPI eases inflation worries.

text.p: A subdued December reading on the U.S. core Consumer Price Index (CPI) soothed the worst of the credit markets' anxieties about an inflation revival and made a Federal Reserve official interest rate hike look less imminent and less likely, analysts said.

The government reported that the overall CPI rose 0.3 percent, as most economists had forecast. Simultaneously, it reported that retail sales rose 0.6 percent in December, a bit higher than the 0.5 percent increase economists had predicted.
Filtering the data, the bond market focused on core CPI.
